title: Animation vocabulary
description: Explore how interfaces appear and disappear. Replay six examples, compare their motion, and describe an animation with the right term.
noResults: No matching terms. Try another word.

demo.reducedMotion: Reduced motion is on. Changes appear immediately.

fade.title: Fade in / Fade out
fade.description: Keep the same position and size while changing opacity. Try both directions to see the difference between appearing and disappearing.
fade.note: Watch the card become transparent without moving.

slide-in.title: Slide in
slide-in.description: Bring content into view from an edge. The direction connects its arrival to a place on the screen.
slide-in.note: Choose an edge, then replay the entrance.

scale-in.title: Scale in
scale-in.description: Grow a panel gently into its final size as it becomes visible. A small size change is often enough.
scale-in.note: The panel grows to its resting size without a bounce.

pop-in.title: Pop in
pop-in.description: Go slightly beyond the final size, then settle back. That overshoot gives an arrival a playful emphasis.
pop-in.note: Use slow playback to see the overshoot and return.

reveal.title: Reveal
reveal.description: Uncover an existing surface by moving a clipping boundary. The content itself stays in place.
reveal.note: Watch the left edge uncover the picture and caption together.

enter-exit.title: Enter / Exit
enter-exit.description: Animate the arrival and removal of an item. Keep it visible during its exit, then remove it when that motion finishes.
enter-exit.note: Remove the notification, then add it again. The exit is shorter.
